title: Shallow Logging Abstractions
pattern: Creating a distinct class, structure, or interface whose sole purpose is wrapping single-line log statements.
why_bad: Introduces useless conceptual weight and high coupling. A programmer reading the call must constantly jump between files to see what fields are logged, and any change in log parameters forces modifications in multiple places [143-144].
detection: A dedicated error-logging class containing several methods that are each invoked in exactly one unique place.
fix: Log the error state directly at the operational site where it is detected.
